name: Ring Road
description: Around the whole island: south-coast waterfalls and black beaches, glacier lagoons, the East Fjords and the lava fields of the north

name: Golden Circle
description: Þingvellir's rift valley, the Geysir field and the Gullfoss falls in a loop from Reykjavík

name: Snæfellsnes
description: Iceland in miniature: Kirkjufell, lava fields, black-sand coves and the Snæfellsjökull glacier volcano

name: Westfjords
description: Gravel and paved roads around deep fjords to Dynjandi falls and the Látrabjarg bird cliffs; slow, remote and quiet

name: Diamond Circle
description: Lake Mývatn, Dettifoss, the Ásbyrgi canyon and Húsavík in the north

name: South Coast (Route 1)
description: Seljalandsfoss and Skógafoss, Reynisfjara's basalt beach and Vík, out to the Jökulsárlón glacier lagoon

name: Kjölur (F35)
description: Highland gravel route between two glaciers to the Hveravellir hot springs; summer only, high-clearance cars

name: East Fjords
description: The coast road around the East Fjords' fishing villages between Höfn and Egilsstaðir
